messages:
mike_marketing: Quick heads-up — we're planning to publish the 'Throughput vs Latency' benchmark blog tomorrow at 9:00 AM PT. Need press coordination, CEO quote clearance, and final assets. Embargo until publish time. :eyes:
jess_pr: Copy. Is there an embargo time we should tell press? also need the final one-sentence pitch for the PR distribution list.
mike_marketing: Embargo until 9:00 AM PT exactly. Pitch: 'Redwood Inference releases industry benchmark showing 2–5x cost reductions for production LLM inference across common workloads.'
ali_engineering: Assets: I uploaded the final graphs + raw CSVs to /shared/benchmarks/2025-05. Screenshots are export-ready. If PR needs high-res PNGs, use `python tools/export_bench.py --input raw.csv --output figs/highres`
jess_pr: perfect. Can we get a short technical blurb (2-3 lines) explaining methodology for the release? press will ask.
ali_engineering: 2-liner: 'We evaluated representative LLM inference workloads across three model sizes and three GPU configs. Measurements include tail latency (p99), throughput, and cost-per-token with/without prefix caching.'
mike_marketing: @kevin_ceo need sign-off on the quoted paragraph and the headline. Can you review? I've pasted the proposed quote below:
"We built Redwood Inference to make production-grade LLMs predictable and affordable — this benchmark shows the economics of that work at scale."
kevin_ceo: skimmed — small tweak: change 'at scale' -> 'in production'. So: "...economics of that work in production." Approve for quote.
sophia_support: FYI support team will be on alert for social and initial inbound for the first 4 hours after publish. Please send the support playbook link when ready.
mike_marketing: Support playbook link: https://drive.redwood/support/playbooks/benchmark-launch-2025.pdf. Also adding a short FAQ to the blog for likely questions.
jess_pr: timeline checklist: 1) Final assets in drive (done) 2) CEO quote (approved) 3) Press list + embargo note sent to top-tier contacts at 4:30 PM PT today 4) Blog scheduled in CMS for 9:00 AM PT 5) Social posts queued 6) Post-mortem call scheduled 1 PM PT tomorrow. Any objections?
ali_engineering: CMS publish hook needs the release flag `bench_publish=true` in the frontmatter. I've tested on staging. Also add `noindex: true` to staging copy.
mike_marketing: noted. @deploy-bot can you schedule the CMS publish job for 2025-05-24T16:00:00Z (which is 9:00 AM PT) and keep it under embargo until then?
deploy-bot: publish job created: job_id=bench-20250524-09, scheduled_time=1753460400, embargo=true. :white_check_mark:
mike_marketing: Thanks — last ask: if any press pushes for early commenting, do not comment and route to PR. We'll send the embargo note to our list at 4:30 PM PT. :rocket:
jess_pr: I'll send the embargo email at 4:30 and ping top-tier contacts directly. I'll attach a short Q&A and offer interviews.
sophia_support: Support team stood up, rotation assigned. I'll paste the Slack triage channel when email goes out.
mike_marketing: Great team — thanks. I'll post a final 'ready' here at 4:15 PM PT.
kevin_ceo: Awesome work everyone. :tada:
